limitations: Automatic routes are configured for 15 senior men’s domestic leagues in Europe, South America, Asia, Australia and South Africa; source availability and identity holds are listed separately.
Cups, other leagues and older history retain their saved snapshot until their adapters are enabled. Global historical coverage is incomplete.
259 inherited mixed-identity matches remain unresolved. Ratings are descriptive within the documented corpus.
